title: Portable restart state and resolved runtime identity
numerical_oracle: Direct CPU strict reference with exact stable-ID coverage and declared finite-state tolerances

snapshot_schema.current: V1 particle state remains supported for the current same-rank contract
snapshot_schema.target: V2 backend-neutral payload with explicit compatibility rejection for incomplete state
snapshot_schema.derived_state: recomputed after decode and redistribution rather than serialized as an opaque cache

rank_count_change.source_rank_count: serialized in the V2 restart state
rank_count_change.destination_rank_count: taken from the current execution topology
rank_count_change.transaction: decode, validate, repartition, and commit only after all destination state is valid

backend_identity.initial_fast_manifest: runtime-selected is permitted only before backend selection
backend_identity.final_manifest: must record the resolved backend and device identity before persistent output is complete
backend_identity.fast: cpu or hip with the resolved device boundary

compatibility.v1_read: accepted only under the existing particle-state and same-rank contract
compatibility.v2_write: required for portable state and rank-count-changing restart
compatibility.v1_rank_count_change: rejected with an explicit compatibility status
compatibility.public_api: C ABI and C++ wrapper remain unchanged

planned_cases.name: complete-state-round-trip
planned_cases.contract: V2 round-trip preserves particle, integrator, RNG, units, math, and ownership state

planned_cases.name: same-rank-byte-parity
planned_cases.contract: uninterrupted and V2 save/reload/resume strict CPU runs produce byte-identical final state

planned_cases.name: rank-count-changing-restart
planned_cases.contract: V2 restart from N source ranks to M destination ranks preserves stable-ID coverage and matches the Direct CPU tolerance oracle

planned_cases.name: resolved-fast-backend-identity
planned_cases.contract: final fast manifests record cpu or hip and the resolved device; runtime-selected cannot remain in completed persistent output

planned_cases.name: transactional-restart-rejection
planned_cases.contract: incomplete state, invalid ownership metadata, checksum errors, and active communication leave destination state unchanged

acceptance.implementation_registration: convert planned cases into TST-P9 identifiers and CTest entries when P9 implementation begins
acceptance.qualification: CPU strict reference is mandatory; MPI rank-change and HIP backend identity are capability-gated evidence lanes

migration.legacy_v1: read-only compatibility remains explicit and cannot claim portable restart
migration.manifest: schema and backend identity changes are versioned before V2 publication
migration.rollback: failed conversion or repartition never replaces the source-compatible destination state
